title: Add RecipeDiscovery scanner
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeDiscovery.swift with a FolderSection struct (name: String, recipes: [RecipeFile]) and a scan(folderURL:) function. Scans only the top level of the given folder URL: .cook files directly under the root go into a '(no folder)' section sorted last; each immediate subdirectory becomes its own named section. Hidden entries (names starting with '.') are skipped. Sections sorted alphabetically; recipes within each section sorted case-insensitively. Security-scoped resource access must be bracketed.
acceptance_criteria: CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeDiscovery.swift exists
FolderSection struct has name: String and recipes: [RecipeFile]
Root-level .cook files appear in a section named '(no folder)' sorted last
Immediate subdirectories each produce one named section
No recursion beyond one level — subdirectories of subdirectories are ignored
Hidden files and dotfolders (leading '.') are skipped
Only .cook files included (case-insensitive extension check)
Sections sorted alphabetically; '(no folder)' always last
Recipes within each section sorted alphabetically case-insensitively
startAccessingSecurityScopedResource / stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource brackets every read
